rule: Filled and signed by the OWNER only. A GO is never inferred from passing tests. C9 remains PENDING until this document is completed and recorded.
prerequisites: C8 = PASS (independent human reviewer signed H1–H8)
All hashes MATCH from disk at decision time
Any change after freeze voids the release (new cycle required)

decisionFields.goNoGo: NO-GO (default until owner writes GO explicitly)
decisionFields.authorizationScope: e.g., signing only / signing + broadcast / read-only rehearsal
decisionFields.targetNetwork: e.g., Core Mainnet (chainId 1116) — exact value required
decisionFields.targetContract: e.g., EvidenceRegistryV2 at <address> — exact value required
decisionFields.operationBounds: max transactions, max value, time window, allowed functions
decisionFields.evidenceReviewed: list of report hashes the owner actually reviewed
decisionFields.independentReviewers: names/roles of the C7 and C8 signers
decisionFields.validity: explicit expiry (date/UTC) — old authorizations never renew themselves
decisionFields.signingOnly: does authorization include broadcast execution, or signature generation only?
decisionFields.executionAuthorization: separate approval record id — execution is a distinct, pre-reviewed, bounded phase

ownerSignatureBlock.note: Signing this template with goNoGo=GO records the owner authorization. Execution still requires the separate execution authorization and a pre-reviewed runbook.
